Roadmap & Call for Help

is not intended to be built by a single team or locked to a single framework. It is designed as a shared foundation for modern state management that can evolve through a world-wide, framework-agnostic community.

This is an opportunity for engineers across ecosystems—Angular, React, Next.js, and beyond—to collaborate on a common set of state primitives, behaviors, and tooling. Rather than fragmenting solutions per framework, aims to provide a shared core that frameworks can build on together.

This page outlines where the project stands today, what is already complete, and where help from the community can have the greatest impact.

TL;DR

is designed to grow through a shared, cross-framework community. The core system is intentionally stable and focused, while many advanced capabilities are built as behaviors that can evolve independently.

  • The foundation is solid, production-ready, and already feature-rich
  • Many powerful behaviors are complete and available today
  • Upcoming features are designed to be modular, extensible, and community-driven
  • Contributions can shape how evolves across frameworks

If you care about predictable state, streaming workflows, and clean ownership boundaries, this roadmap is an open invitation to help build the next generation of state management— together.

Project Repositories

is organized into a small set of focused repositories. Each repository has a clear responsibility and is designed to evolve independently while sharing a common core philosophy.

  • /addons
    Addon behaviors and controllers. Framework-agnostic.
  • /core
    Core runtime, pipeline, FeatureCell, Vault, behaviors, and contracts. Framework-agnostic.
  • /angular
    Angular integration, Signals support, DI adapters, and Angular-specific tooling.
  • /devtools
    Chrome DevTools extension, InsightService consumers, and observability tooling.
